clients.purpose: Advanced from 0aa78899 to re-pin the short, human-friendly URL schema (backend PR #464 / frontend PR #732) after the last two raw-id fallbacks were closed: it adds UploadedDownloadableFileDiscussion.channels {channelUniqueName, discussionNumber} for the uploads page and ScratchpadEntry.sourceCommentShortId for scratchpad comment permalinks, on top of the per-forum discussion/event numbers, comment shortId, per-user image/album/collection numbers, their getXIdByNumber lookups, and the secondary-projection number fields (contribution feeds, ScratchpadEntry, Issue related event/comment, download-scan and campaign-failure items). Frontend #732 parses the number/shortId from route params, resolves it to the id, and builds links from these fields. Pinned to backend 9c549bd3 (clean export, schema SHA-256 9b0e713b…); the additive 366-operation contract re-validated against it.
